dcl_globalFlags refactoringAllowed
dcl_sampler s0, mode_default
dcl_resource_texture2d (float,float,float,float) t0

dcl_input_ps linear v3.xyzw

dcl_output o3.xyzw
dcl_temps 4

mov r1.w, l(1.000000)

  mad r3.xy, r0.wwww, r1.xyxx, l(0.040000, 0.040000, 0.000000, 0.000000)

  mov r3.xy, l(0.040000,0.040000,0,0)
